abstract: Sperm karyotype analysis was performed on testicular cancer patients before and after treatment with BEP (bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin). A total of 788 sperm chromosome complements was studied, 236 before chemotherapy (CT) and 552 post-CT. There was no significant difference in the total frequency of sperm chromosomal abnormalities pre-CT (10.2%) compared to post-CT (10.7%). Similarly, there were no significant differences in the frequencies of numerical abnormalities (2.5% pre-CT vs. 2.4% post-CT) or structural abnormalities (6.4% pre-CT vs. 7.4% post-CT). The percentage of X-bearing sperm was also not significantly different before (46.3%) and after CT (50.1%). The results in cancer patients were not significantly different from those in control donors. This study corroborates results from our previous analysis of these same men using multicolor fluorescence in situ hybridization for assessment of aneuploidy for chromosomes 1, 12, X, Y, and XY. Together, these two studies suggest that the sperm of men receiving BEP chemotherapy are not at increased risk of chromosomal abnormalities two or more years after treatment.
abstract_ja: 精巣がん患者を対象に、BEP療法(ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン)の前後で精子核型解析を行った。解析した精子染色体は計788体で、化学療法前が236体、化学療法後が552体であった。染色体異常の全体頻度は、化学療法前10.2%、化学療法後10.7%と有意差はなかった。数的異常(化学療法前2.5%、化学療法後2.4%)および構造異常(化学療法前6.4%、化学療法後7.4%)の頻度にも有意差はなかった。X染色体を持つ精子の割合も、化学療法前(46.3%)と化学療法後(50.1%)で有意差はなかった。がん患者の結果は対照ドナーのものと有意差はなかった。本研究は、多色蛍光in situハイブリダイゼーション法を用いて1、12、X、Y染色体の異数性を評価した先行研究と同じ男性を対象とした解析を裏付けるものである。両研究を合わせると、BEP化学療法を受けた男性の精子は、治療後2年以上経過しても染色体異常のリスクが高まるとは考えられない。
